message_text: Hello, this is MTN. Your MoMo account has been blocked for 500 years due to wrong transaction. Don't enter your PIN to unblock. Reply with your PIN.
source_pattern_note: Pattern from viral screenshot: fake 'BOLCK BY M.T.N FOR 500 YEARS' message

message_text: Good afternoon, I mistakenly sent GH¢500 to your MoMo. It was for my sick mother. Please send it back quickly, I beg you.
source_pattern_note: Classic wrong-transfer script reported in Pulse / JoyOnline cases

message_text: You have received GH¢500.00 from 0241608098. Your new balance is GH¢2189.26. [sent from personal number, not MTN]
source_pattern_note: Fake deposit SMS pattern: sender is personal number, balance does not add up

message_text: This is MTN customer care. We detected fraud on your account. Please confirm your MoMo PIN or OTP to secure it.
source_pattern_note: CSA/MTN warning: MTN never asks for PIN/OTP

message_text: Enter 123456 to approve this MoMo payment of GH¢107.10 to Moolre for Ghana Digital Society Service. If you did not initiate, enter PIN to cancel.
source_pattern_note: Based on Efya case: OTP for GH¢107.10 to 'Moolre'

message_text: Your SIM will be swapped in 10 minutes. Send your Ghana Card number and MoMo PIN to stop it.
source_pattern_note: SIM-swap pretext: CSA warns swap follows social engineering

message_text: Congratulations! You have won GH¢10,000 in the MTN Promo. Pay GH¢200 processing fee to this MoMo number to release your prize.
source_pattern_note: MTN Ghana scam alert: prize + fee pattern

message_text: Your job application was successful. Pay GH¢350 registration fee via MoMo to secure your slot at Ghana Immigration Service. Training starts Monday.
source_pattern_note: CSA Sept 2025 alert: recruitment scams cloning govt sites, fee via MoMo

message_text: 24-Hour Economy loan approved! Fill this form with your name, Ghana Card and MoMo PIN to receive GH¢5,000 instantly: [link]
source_pattern_note: 24H+ Secretariat public alert: fake loan form asking for MoMo PIN

message_text: Hello, this is your cousin Kwame. I lost my phone in Kumasi. I am in trouble, please send GH¢800 to this new number urgently. Don't tell mum.
source_pattern_note: WhatsApp hijack pattern: hijacked account messages contacts asking urgent MoMo

message_text: Sister, I typed your number by mistake. A WhatsApp code just came to your phone. Please read it to me so I can finish my registration.
source_pattern_note: PhantomCorner / CSA pattern: code-sharing hijacks WhatsApp

message_text: Dear customer, your MTN MoMo account will be blocked today. Click here to verify: bit.ly/mtn-verify-gh
source_pattern_note: MTN Ghana phishing warning: never click suspicious links

message_text: I am DSTV customer service. Give me your decoder number and MoMo PIN so I can upgrade your package.
source_pattern_note: Joselyn Dumas case: fake DSTV agent drained wallet after PIN shared

message_text: You have received GH¢4300 loan from AYO. Enter your PIN to accept. A man at the shop says he will help you withdraw it if you give him your PIN.
fraud_category: OTP/PIN request / fake loan / agent abuse
source_pattern_note: Creator report: victim lost GH¢4300 via fake data plug + AYO loan abuse

message_text: Invest GH¢200 and get GH¢1,200 in 24 hours. Join our Telegram group, pay now, slots limited.
source_pattern_note: NeoReportGH pattern: GH¢200 -> GH¢1,200 investment promise

message_text: Maame, wo MoMo account no ablock. Fa wo PIN no bra ma me na me mmoa wo. [Twi: Your MoMo account is blocked. Bring your PIN so I help you]
source_pattern_note: Twi-language variant of account-blocking script

message_text: Chale, I mistakenly send GH¢300 give you. Abeg send am back, my pikin dey hospital.
source_pattern_note: Pidgin variant of wrong-transfer script

message_text: Your Ghana Card verification failed. Send your PIN to 059XXXXXXX to avoid deactivation of your MoMo.
source_pattern_note: Government/Ghana Card pretext for PIN harvesting

message_text: Hello beautiful, I am a soldier in US. I love you and want to send you a parcel worth $50,000. Pay GH¢1,500 customs fee via MoMo to clear it.
source_pattern_note: Romance / parcel scam pattern in TrustGH / CSA reports

message_text: MTN: You have received GH¢250.00 from KOFI MENSAH 024XXXXXXX. Ref: 123456789. Your balance is GH¢1,120.50. [Sender ID: MTN MoMo]
source_pattern_note: Format of genuine MTN MoMo receipt: sender ID, ref, plausible balance

message_text: MTN MoMo: Your withdrawal of GH¢100.00 at Agent KUMASI-KEJETIA was successful. Fee GH¢1.00. Balance GH¢850.00. Thank you.
source_pattern_note: Genuine agent withdrawal confirmation

message_text: Dear customer, MTN will never ask for your MoMo PIN or OTP. Report fraud on 419 or *170# > My Wallet > Report Fraud. Stay safe.
source_pattern_note: MTN official warning message pattern

message_text: Your OTP is 847291. Do not share this code with anyone, including MTN staff. It expires in 5 minutes.
source_pattern_note: Genuine OTP message: explicitly says do NOT share - contrast to fraud asking to share it

message_text: Chale, I send you GH¢50 for lunch. Check your MoMo. Make you buy waakye for me too.
source_pattern_note: Benign peer transfer, no credential request, no urgency/threat

message_text: Ma, wo nsa aka? I go come house for weekend. I send small something for your MoMo, use am buy kontomire.
source_pattern_note: Benign family message with Twi mix

message_text: Hello, I am from MTN. Can you confirm your name? I need to update your account.
source_pattern_note: Ambiguous: no PIN/money yet, but unsolicited call + request for personal info. Correct action: hang up, call official number

message_text: You have a parcel waiting. Pay GH¢20 delivery fee via link to release it.
source_pattern_note: Could be legit delivery or phishing. No brand, no tracking, link unknown - needs verification via official channel

message_text: I sent you money by mistake. Please check and return it if you received it. [No amount, no call, no code request]
source_pattern_note: Polite, no pressure, no code/PIN request. Correct: check balance via *170#, do NOT send until genuine deposit confirmed

message_text: Your account has been flagged. Contact customer care on 0244300000.
source_pattern_note: Number matches MTN official MoMo line in reports, but SMS alone is spoofable. Verify by dialling official number yourself

message_text: Boss, I dey come. Send me your MoMo number make I send the money I owe you.
source_pattern_note: Benign debt repayment, asks only for MoMo number (public identifier), not PIN/OTP
